one_liner: CurvedVid_with_link_input displays a video on a mesh, using either an uploaded file or a URL, with auto‑play, looping and 16:9 aspect.
primary_use_case: Showcase video content on a screen mesh in a Hyperfy world, supporting direct upload or streaming link.
preview_recommendation: Use the provided MP4 preview to verify that the video loads, respects the mesh geometry, loops correctly, and that the UI fields accept both file uploads and URLs.
manifest_quality_notes: Large video asset (~15 MB) may affect client performance.
Fallback to videoLink works if no file is uploaded.
No server‑side logic; runs only on client.
